interpretation: Uniform nonzero ballast; page caches cleared before each outbound move, modules retained after first use. Return can reuse pages. Capture-to-arrival-hook receipt includes the ACK return trip; CLI confirmation measured separately. Constant ballast is highly compressible, not a network-bandwidth benchmark.
storage_followup: Current Mac write 334 MB/s versus historical 45; CM5 434 versus 397. Older discrepancy did not reproduce at the same scale. Current read validates every byte and is a different workload from historical unchecked reads; compiler/configuration differ. No unique root cause established.
failed_attempt: SSH selected scoped link-local IPv6; fixed IPv4 address discovery before any measured moves. Failed launch excluded.
timing_correction: This initial campaign measured host-record preparation, not instance restore. Instance activation/restore is included in arrival acknowledgement time but was not isolated. The follow-up adds a dedicated destination activation timer.
